title: VS Code Projects Dock — window state file
description: One file per open VS Code window, named {windowId}.json, written to the shared state directory and rewritten on a heartbeat. Liveness is determined by file mtime; lastSeen is belt-and-suspenders.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking change to this shape.

windowId.description: Stable, unique-per-window identifier. Used as the filename key. Source confirmed in Phase 0 (Group 1).

folderUri.description: The opened workspace folder URI. Carries the remote authority for remote windows (e.g. vscode-remote://wsl+Ubuntu/home/michael/project). The dock's match key.

displayName.description: Leaf of the folder path. Used only for the button label.

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last heartbeat write. The dock may rely on file mtime instead; this keeps the payload self-describing and transport-independent.
